name: widget
title: Widget
description: A piece of interface a model sends as JSON (a card with a date and a Confirm key, a list of results, a progress line), rendered with MetalUI's own components. The JSON is untrusted: only the nodes and props in the published schema (widgets.schema.json) pass, URLs only http, https or mailto, and what can't be shown reads quietly in place. Keys never act: they hand { type: "action", name, payload } and the fields' values to the host.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/widget.md. SwiftUI: MetalWidget in the MetalUI Swift package.
